Ack.description: Response of a command that was accepted (effects show up in /state).
Ack.title: Ack

ConfigPushRequest.description: A whole vbc.yaml from a client (`vbc config --push FILE`).
ConfigPushRequest.title: ConfigPushRequest

ConfigPushResult.description: The pushed config was saved; it takes effect at the next server start.
ConfigPushResult.title: ConfigPushResult

ConfigView.description: Effective configuration, structured per section (no preformatted text).
ConfigView.title: ConfigView

DirEntry.description:
One input folder. ``metadata``: the folder holds JSON manifests (multipart
jobs) instead of videos. ``watch``: new files start work without a refresh.
Fields left out (null) keep the saved values of a listed folder; for a new
folder the server detects them: manifests inside -> metadata and watch,
network file system -> polling (inotify misses other hosts' writes).
DirEntry.title: DirEntry

DirsScanResult.description: ``POST /dirs/scan``: media mounts newly added to the list (disabled).
DirsScanResult.title: DirsScanResult

MediaInfo.description: Source stream facts the server already knows (for display only).
MediaInfo.title: MediaInfo

Problem.description: Error body for 4xx responses (field errors for 422).
Problem.title: Problem

SourceCleanupRequest.description: Find sources that already have a verified output; delete them only with ``delete``.
SourceCleanupRequest.title: SourceCleanupRequest

StopRequest.description: Stop processing (the server keeps running; refresh resumes).
StopRequest.title: StopRequest

VersionsView.description:
What the server runs with; read once per process. A value is null when
the tool is missing or did not answer (e.g. no NVIDIA driver).
VersionsView.title: VersionsView

info.description: Control plane of vbc serve: status and commands, never media.
info.title: VBC API

post.description: An interactive client ends its session (logged as a disconnect).

put.description: Save a client's vbc.yaml (server-owned sections kept); applies at the next start.

post.description: Offer new media mounts as disabled folders.
Recompress supported failed manifests (FFmpeg 244/-12: video without audio).
Put a failed manifest (and its archived sources) back into the metadata folder.
Start finding (delete: and deleting) sources that already have a verified output.

Stop processing (graceful: jobs finish; interrupt: now). The server keeps
running; POST /refresh resumes. Repeating it is a no-op.

get.description: VBC, ffmpeg (and its libraries), exiftool, NVIDIA driver, image packages.
